shots: Stormy night exterior of the same abandoned hospital, police lights reflected on wet ground.
Jian Ci in a white forensic coat and Lin Qian in navy uniform enter with flashlights.
A restrained non-graphic skeletal-remains discovery in the dark second-floor corridor.
Jian Ci kneels in his white coat and studies the remains without touching unsealed evidence.

dialogue.zh: 容器-07来自钟远旧案，登记地就是这家医院。
dialogue.en: Container-07 came from Zhong Yuan's old case; it was registered to this hospital.

shots: Forensic close shot of ribs and a black-gloved examination tool; no gore.
Lin Qian gives a controlled questioning reaction, chin-length black bob and navy uniform clear.
Jian Ci points out an abnormal joint and a metal trace while keeping chain-of-custody discipline.
Zhou Qiao, silver-rim glasses and hearing device, analyzes the clue on a dark portable terminal.

dialogue.zh: 检刺，钟远为何藏进刀柄？
dialogue.en: Jian Ci, why did Zhong Yuan hide it in the handle?
Someone wanted the old case buried.

shots: Xu Wei, high ponytail and olive forensic coverall, photographs and collects a subtle trace.
Han Che, mature square face and dark jacket, makes a restrained procedural judgment.
Macro evidence shot: clean tweezers lift one tiny metal particle into a sealed sample container.
The five-person team confers in the same corridor and decides on composition comparison.

dialogue.zh: 许未，遗骸暴露数周，骨内有金属微粒。
dialogue.en: Xu Wei, the remains were exposed for weeks, and there are metal particles in the bone.

shots: Jian Ci reviews the sealed metal-composition result in the cold forensic lab.
Lin Qian traces a recent racing lead by phone and case terminal.
A red racing car cuts through rain on a closed track; no crash spectacle.
Clear first identity portrait of Su Wang, age 22, warmer softer rounder face, blunt forward fringe and dark civilian racing clothing.

dialogue.zh: 碎屑来自赛车刹车盘，车手苏望成了关键。
dialogue.en: The fragments came from a racing brake disc; driver Su Wang became the key.

shots: Jian Ci checks the lab comparison report, white coat and black gloves unmistakable.
Zhou Qiao analyzes race telemetry on a dark terminal, glasses and hearing device visible.
Xu Wei compares the brake-disc report with the sealed particle result.
Han Che gives a concise phone order to trace Su Wang.

dialogue.en: During the race, Su Wang suddenly fled.
Zhou Qiao, trace his whereabouts.

shots: Jian Ci listens to the recorded racing evidence and notices only a subtle anomaly.
Lin Qian realizes the medical implication without exaggerated acting.
Extreme close shot of Jian Ci's eyes with a very brief deep-burgundy glint; this is only perception, never proof.
The five-person team gathers around the evidence and chooses garage 302 as the next search location.

dialogue.zh: 林浅，死亡时间被人为延后。
dialogue.en: Lin Qian, the apparent time of death was deliberately delayed.
The killer understands medicine.

shots: Exterior close shot of the half-open garage 302 door; do not create readable extra text beyond the simple number plaque.
The team enters the same narrow abandoned repair garage with flashlights.
Jian Ci studies the unusually clean floor and tire-thread oil trace.
Macro view of the wiped streak and one thin physical trace, collected with black gloves.

dialogue.en: The truth is hidden in Room 302.
This place is too clean.
Yet there is thread oil.

shots: Xu Wei opens a concealed medical box containing transplant tools, anesthetic and sutures; no surgical procedure is shown.
Zhou Qiao retrieves the hemostat and anesthetic purchase records on his terminal.
Lin Qian compares the sealed DNA and victim records.
Han Che gives a restrained stern reaction and asks what Su Wang concealed.

dialogue.en: Transplant instruments were hidden here.
Su Wang bought anesthetic.
Han Che, the evidence is complete.

shots: Jian Ci in the white forensic coat notices a water stain and directs the team to it.
A dark-red residual blood trace is found beneath the wiped surface; restrained and non-graphic.
Ultraviolet blue light reveals an incomplete cleanup pattern across the same surface.
The team confirms that the independent traces point toward Su Wang while motive remains unknown.

dialogue.zh: 看这里，血迹没有清干净。
dialogue.en: Look here—the blood was not completely cleaned away.

shots: Dark corridor and interrogation-room door silhouette; no generated readable sign.
Wide shot: Su Wang in a dark rolled-sleeve civilian shirt sits opposite Lin Qian; Jian Ci stands separately in his white forensic coat.
Lin Qian places the sealed residual-blood DNA report on the steel table.
Jian Ci in white coat and black gloves explains the evidentiary limit of anesthetic and sutures.

dialogue.zh: 残血把苏望带进审讯室。
dialogue.en: Residual blood brought Su Wang into interrogation.
The DNA is yours.
But it only proves you treated an injury.

shots: Jian Ci opens the evidence record with black-gloved hands and white cuffs visible while Su Wang says offscreen that he tried to save the victim.
Su Wang, clearly different softer face and dark civilian shirt, finishes his line while Jian Ci begins the alloy explanation offscreen.
Sealed remains photograph, metal-particle vial and brake-disc alloy comparison fill the frame while Jian Ci continues the explanation offscreen.
Jian Ci observes Su Wang's stress response as Su Wang challenges the proof offscreen; Han Che remains behind observation glass.

dialogue.en: I tried to save him.
The particles in the bone match the brake disc.
That does not prove it was me.

shots: Jian Ci in the unmistakable white coat watches silently while Lin Qian states offscreen that the purchase records also match.
Su Wang in the dark rolled-sleeve shirt lowers his head, guarded but not melodramatic.
Jian Ci is held chest-up with his white coat and angular pale face clearly visible while he asks whom Su Wang wanted to wake; Su Wang answers offscreen.
Direct match cut from the same Jian Ci face to an extreme close-up of both Jian Ci irises turning deep burgundy for 0.8 seconds, then cut to black.

dialogue.en: The purchase records also match.
Su Wang, whom did you want to wake?
I only wanted him to wake up.
